name: branding-teal-and-indigo-colour-block-portraits-with-supplement-tubs
title: Woman in teal and man in indigo on matching backdrops each holding a gummy and a tub
whatItIs: A split image with a smiling woman in headphones and glasses in teal on a teal backdrop and a smiling bearded man in an indigo tee on indigo, each pinching a gummy near the face and holding a tub of their product line.
whatItMeans: Upbeat and inclusive; head-to-toe colour matching turns each person into a brand swatch.
techniques: Match clothing, backdrop and pack accent colours.
Repeat the same pose in both frames.
Use a gummy near the smile as a focal detail.
Place the table edge as a horizontal base.

vocabulary.definition: Clothing and backdrop in one hue.
The same gesture in every frame of a set.
An image tailored to one audience.
A flat surface line anchoring a portrait.
